description: This file contains platform-specific functions for checking and performing firmware upgrades based on the board type, specifically for D-Link DIR-685. It defines functions to check the image and to perform an upgrade, with conditional logic depending on the hardware.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks if the upgrade image is compatible with the current platform, returning success for DIR-685 boards, otherwise printing an unsupported message.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the firmware upgrade process on specific boards, in this case, DIR-685, by calling the default upgrade method with a specified partition name.
